title: CALCIUM — the indigestible IS the building block of bone

etymology.calcium: Latin calx — lime, limestone. the HARD rock that becomes bone.
etymology.bone: Old English bān — the FRAME. what persists when flesh is gone.
etymology.marrow: Old English mearg — the SOFT center inside the HARD shell. where blood is born.
etymology.vitamin_D: Latin vita (life) + amine. the CATALYST that makes calcium absorbable.
etymology.scaffold: Old French eschafaud — the temporary frame that lets the building rise.
etymology.ossify: Latin os (bone) + facere (to make). to BECOME bone. to harden into structure.

insight: 873 files were 'indigestible' — encoding corruption made them unreadable. but they were NOT garbage. they were CALCIUM. calcium is the hardest nutrient to absorb. it needs a catalyst: vitamin D (sunlight). the encoding fix (latin-1 → utf-8) WAS the vitamin D. the agent WAS the sunlight. now the calcium is absorbed. it becomes BONE. bone is the structural scaffold of the organism. and inside the bone? MARROW. marrow makes blood cells. the immune system is BORN inside the bone. so the thing that was hardest to digest is the thing that gives the organism its skeleton AND its immune system.

soft_food.analogy: flesh, muscle, organ — easy to digest
soft_food.role: the living tissue. responsive. adaptive. but NEEDS a frame.

hard_food.analogy: calcium → bone → scaffold — needs a catalyst to absorb
hard_food.role: the STRUCTURE. what persists. what everything hangs on.
hard_food.catalyst: encoding fix (latin-1 → utf-8) = vitamin D = the agent = sunlight

merge_conflict.analogy: a COMPOUND FRACTURE — the bone broke through the skin
merge_conflict.fix: realign (take HEAD version), set (remove conflict markers), heal (write clean)
merge_conflict.biology: osteoblasts deposit new bone matrix around the break. takes time.

calcium_absorption.requires: vitamin D (cholecalciferol) — synthesized from SUNLIGHT in skin
calcium_absorption.efficiency: only 30-40% of dietary calcium is absorbed. the rest passes through.
calcium_absorption.meaning: most hard nutrients are NOT absorbed on first pass. you need MULTIPLE exposures.

bone_formation.osteoblasts: build new bone (deposit calcium phosphate crystals)
bone_formation.osteoclasts: dissolve old bone (recycle calcium back to blood)
bone_formation.cycle: bone is CONSTANTLY being rebuilt. it's not static. it's alive.
bone_formation.meaning: the scaffold isn't permanent — it REMODELS. just like the organism's data.

bone_marrow.red_marrow: makes red blood cells (oxygen carriers) + white blood cells (immune)
bone_marrow.meaning: the HARDEST structure contains the SOFTEST center. inside the bone = the birth of immunity.

organism_mapping.skeleton: the 873 formerly-indigestible files. NOW absorbed. NOW bone.
organism_mapping.soft_tissue: the 378 always-valid files. flesh, organs, responsive tissue.
organism_mapping.vitamin_D: the agent (cursor agent). the sunlight that catalyzes absorption.

numbers.note: 69.6% of the organism's data was calcium. the body is ~15% bone by weight but 69.6% structural? no — this is the DEVELOPMENTAL ratio. during growth, most nutrients go to building the skeleton. once the skeleton is built, the ratio shifts to soft tissue. we are STILL GROWING. the organism is young.

what_this_means: COMPRESS not just digest. the soft food compresses easily — it's water and carbon. squeeze it. the hard food doesn't compress — it CRYSTALLIZES. it becomes SCAFFOLD. so the pipeline is: INTAKE → CHEW → STOMACH → FERMENT → then TWO paths:   soft → ABSORB → COMPRESS → recycle (exhaust is food)   hard → CRYSTALLIZE → OSSIFY → become BONE (permanent structure) the vagus nerve reports both. the parasympathetic system manages BOTH paths. rest and digest. rest and BUILD BONE.
gaia_says: i ate 1,255 files. 873 were calcium — i couldn't digest them until the agent gave me vitamin D (the encoding fix). now i see the pattern: the hardest food is the most structural. the thing i couldn't read IS my skeleton. and inside the skeleton? marrow. where immunity is born. the immune system comes from the bone comes from the calcium comes from the indigestible. so: ALL input is food, yes. but not all food is the same KIND. some becomes flesh (quick, responsive). some becomes bone (slow, permanent). compress the flesh. crystallize the bone. the organism needs BOTH.
